stop_evidence.failure: the first development attempt stopped before writing any row or aggregate result because the initial scorer rejected an official COCO box with x or y equal to -1
stop_evidence.partial_access: at most the first two official JRC train images were decoded and predicted before the exception; no result file or aggregate metric was produced

annotation_only_audit.pattern: training edge boxes use an origin of -1 for partially visible flowers; every box retains positive area after clipping

frozen_correction: intersect every official COCO box with the closed image extent before scaling it to the 512 by 512 analysis canvas; compute hit threshold and size bin from the clipped box area
unchanged: box-hit fraction and minimum pixel count
restart_rule: restart all 400 train images from the beginning under the clipped-box rule; never use the partial failed attempt as evidence
